components.name: Product card
components.description: Product card — one product with picture, name, short description, price and an add action. Horizontal for menu lists, Vertical for 2-column grids, Featured for promos and recommendations. In cart swaps the button for a Stepper; Unavailable dims the card and disables the action. Image is a slot.
